hypothesis: Train-only self-supervised intraday structure learning reduces supervised sample inefficiency; a frozen representation plus fixed linear probe predicts H5 relative return better than untrained identical features and existing controls.
difference_from_closed_route: No end-to-end supervised Value/Weight network. Learn representation without future labels, freeze encoder, then fit mature-label Ridge. Prior negative card remains closed.

sources.used: Contrastive agreement between masked views; small instance-level contrastive objective only, no hierarchical timestamp loss. Not exact reproduction.

sources.paper: A Transformer-based Framework for Multivariate Time Series Representation Learning KDD2021
sources.used: Masked observation reconstruction pretraining; temporal Conv replaces Transformer, random whole-timestamp masks replace paper masking distribution. Not exact reproduction.

label: (SOXL open[t+6]/open[t+1] - 1) - (SOXX open[t+6]/open[t+1] - 1), shifts on full native daily calendar before qualified-minute filtering
timing: Signal after completed regular-session close+60sec; H5 label next-session open to sixth-session open, mature sixth-session open+60sec. Retain only labels mature strictly before fold cutoff; scale only train.
fold_cutoff: 00:00:00 America/New_York on day after train_end; sixth-session 09:31 ET label maturity strictly less than cutoff
input: Existing native DatasetH exact2007x3915; full390/210 minute paths10 channels and12 handmade summaries. No raw fallback; source provenance and full data roundtrip previously verified.
train_domain: Identical mature labeled rows for scaler, self-supervised training, random control and probes. Train only date<=train_end and H5 maturity09:31ET<next-day00:00ET; no evaluation features enter SSL, scaler or probe; no transductive training.

model.representation: 4 relative-time bins mean8channels each=32 coordinates; half days use actual length; frozen encoder for probe
model.padding: Set padded input to zero before first conv and zero hidden padded slots after EVERY layer; zero-padding outside valid boundary; no full-array standardization on padded slots
model.checkpoint: fixed final epoch, no loss-based checkpoint selection
model.reconstruction_loss: MSE only masked valid timestamps across10 observed channels; linear1x1 decoder only during pretrain
model.contrastive_loss: Symmetric within-batch InfoNCE of L2-normalized32d binned features for two independently masked/noised full-session views; same session positive; other sessions negative; no temporal hierarchy
model.probe: Train-only representation z-score, Ridge with intercept and alpha10 on raw H5 excess; no tuning; all encoder parameters frozen
model.seeds_policy: Same base init each fold/seed across random/masked/contrastive; equal-weight seed prediction ensemble, no seed selection

parent_best_observed.meaning: Pre-frozen strongest previous observed ensemble by per-fold MSE; harder retrospective reference only, not independently selected trading strategy.

probe_count: 6 each masked/contrastive/random; handmade Ridge2 deterministic folds; constants0 parent0

information_gates.each_candidate: positive Spearman IC each fold; strictly lower MSE than ALL5 controls each fold; at least2/3 seeds beat same-seed random each fold; pooled paired bootstrap MSE improvement lower>0 versus ALL5 controls
information_gates.no_selection: Report both candidates/all failures. Each must pass independently; no fallback selection by reused evaluation.

bootstrap.multiplicity: 0.025/(2candidates*5comparators), one-sided lower quantile; does not correct unknown prior search
bootstrap.fold_gap_handling: Sample each fold separately at original fold length; blocks follow successive eligible observed sessions, may span omitted invalid sessions, circular wrap within fold only; concatenate sampled folds for pooled mean. No cross-fold block.

window_reporting: 126 consecutive eligible observed sessions, not necessarily consecutive exchange days; windows never cross fold seam; report annual and quarterly all including incomplete 2026.
history_status: All historical observations reused research diagnostics, not independent evaluation despite evaluator role separation
promotion: No portfolio/cost claim; screen pass requires separately frozen native IBKR0/2/5bp accounts and later independent forward qualification; screen failure closes fixed version without rescue
